sources.title: Parakeet · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It is used to instantiate a Parakeet model according to the specified arguments, defining the model architecture. Instantiating a configuration with the defaults will yield a similar configuration to that of the nvidia/parakeet-ctc-1.1b

sources.title: nvidia/parakeet-ctc-0.6b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: World-class out-of-the-box accuracy for the most common languages with model checkpoints trained on proprietary data with hundreds of thousands of GPU-compute hours Best in class accuracy with run-time word boosting (e.g., brand and product names) and customization of acoustic model, language model, and inverse text normalization
